installCommand: curl https://sh.rustup.rs -sSf | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && . "$HOME/.cargo/env" && cargo install wasm-pack --version 0.15.1 --locked && bun install --frozen-lockfile

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
